sampling_unit: permanent product/capture group, not augmented crop count
rules: Retain clean dates and Korean role headings as regression controls.
Select recognition-sensitive crops using reviewed crop/text interventions after execution approval.
Do not infer date_fields from transcription or full-image answers.
Use permanent optimizer/inner-validation group roles; split calibration fit and calibration holdout by reviewed group.
Do not use future-round or excluded augmented-test bytes.
Do not count correlated views of a crop as independent confidence evidence.
Difficulty strata need reviewed tags; paper thresholds are not copied as task thresholds.
